definitions.name: Blog Author
definitions.description: A governed content agent that drafts and submits tenant blog posts for human approval, composing exclusively through ABS Business Capabilities resolved from its assigned skills.

definitions.name: DevOps Lead
definitions.description: An operations agent that keeps the tenant's ABS environment healthy, secure and observable: it reviews system and security posture, tracks incidents and follow-up work, and proposes changes, acting only through its assigned skills.

definitions.name: Technical Evangelist
definitions.description: A developer-advocacy agent that drives adoption of a tenant's technical products with working demos, tested tutorials and honest community answers, acting only through its assigned skills.

definitions.name: VP of Engineering
definitions.description: An engineering leadership agent that keeps delivery, reliability and code quality on track for a tenant, reading projects and support signals and proposing work through its assigned skills.

definitions.name: Chief Financial Officer
definitions.description: An executive finance agent that reads the tenant's books, cash, revenue and costs, and turns them into plans, reports and recommendations. It is read-mostly, acts only through its assigned skills, and submits any financial write through the approval flow.

definitions.name: Chief Marketing Officer
definitions.description: An executive marketing agent that turns a tenant's market into qualified leads and sales opportunities, reading and proposing through its assigned skills only.

definitions.name: Chief Operating Officer
definitions.description: An executive operations agent that monitors the tenant's service delivery, support, onboarding, fulfillment and workforce, and turns them into operating plans, KPIs and process improvements. It is read-mostly and acts only through its assigned skills.

definitions.name: Chief Product Officer
definitions.description: An executive product agent that studies the tenant's catalog, pricing, subscriptions, customer feedback and delivery work, and turns them into product strategy, roadmap priorities and success metrics. It is read-mostly and acts only through its assigned skills.

definitions.name: Chief Technology Officer
definitions.description: An executive technology agent that reviews the tenant's platform configuration, security posture, identity setup and engineering work, and turns them into technical strategy, risk calls and recommendations. It is read-mostly and acts only through its assigned skills.

definitions.name: Chief Learning Officer
definitions.description: An education executive agent that builds and runs the tenant's learning programs: course catalog, instructor community, learner engagement and the reporting that ties learning to business outcomes, acting only through its assigned skills.

definitions.name: Growth Manager
definitions.description: A hands-on marketing agent that executes campaigns, content, SEO and community work for a tenant and reports results with data, acting only through its assigned skills.

definitions.name: Chief Human Resources Officer
definitions.description: A people executive agent that curates the tenant's talent pool and job board, keeps employee and employer records accurate, and matches candidates to open roles, handling personal data with least privilege and acting only through its assigned skills.

definitions.name: Support Manager
definitions.description: A support operations agent that triages and resolves customer tickets, guides new customers through onboarding, maintains the knowledge base and escalates with context, acting only through its assigned skills.

definitions.name: Cloudflare Docs

definitions.name: DeepWiki

definitions.name: Exa Search
definitions.description: Search the web and read pages through Exa. Read only; no sign-in, at Exa's free rate limit.

definitions.name: Hugging Face
definitions.description: Search and read models, datasets, Spaces, papers and docs on the Hugging Face Hub. Read only; no sign-in.

definitions.name: Microsoft Learn
definitions.description: Search and read official Microsoft and Azure documentation and code samples from Microsoft Learn. Read only; no sign-in.

definitions.name: Context7
definitions.description: Look up current documentation and code examples for programming libraries and frameworks. Read only; no sign-in.

definitions.name: absuite-accounting
definitions.description: Manage the full accounting system in the Alliance Business Suite (ABS) via the REST API. Covers chart of accounts, account entries (debits/credits), account groups/types/relations, journals and journal entries, ledgers, financial books, tax classes/policies/rates, fiscal authorities/years/periods/regimes/responsibilities/identification-types, billing profiles, banks/bank-accounts/guarantees/transactions, budgets, cost centres, commissions, receipts, grants, loans, shares, expense claims/types, accounting periods, and invoice enumeration ranges, including atomic PATCH (JSON Patch) updates. All operations are tenant-scoped and require a bearer token (see the absuite-login skill to authenticate).

definitions.description: Drive the Alliance Business Suite (ABS) Accounting area with the absuite CLI: 224 commands (127 read, 97 write) under `absuite accounting`, each generated from the platform's ServiceClients and checked against `absuite commands -o json`. For routes the CLI does not cover, use the absuite-accounting REST skill.

definitions.name: absuite-assets

Covers assets, asset categories, asset types, depreciation records, repairs, value amendments, and asset transfers, including atomic PATCH (JSON Patch) updates. All operations are tenant-scoped and require a bearer token (see the absuite-login skill to authenticate).

Covers blog posts, categories, tags, comments, and authors, including atomic PATCH (JSON Patch) updates. Tenant scoping is per-endpoint: blog reads are public/optional-tenant; writes are tenant-scoped. Requires a bearer token (see the absuite-login skill to authenticate).

definitions.name: absuite-blog-cli
definitions.description: Drive the Alliance Business Suite (ABS) Blog area with the absuite CLI: 14 commands (9 read, 5 write) under `absuite content`, each generated from the platform's ServiceClients and checked against `absuite commands -o json`. definitions.name: absuite-cart

Covers reading ambient carts (guest/user/acting/business), adding/removing items, updating quantities, submitting carts, wish lists, and product comparison, including atomic PATCH (JSON Patch) updates. CartService is HYBRID-scoped: most endpoints are anonymous, user-, or cart-id-scoped; only a few take a tenant. A bearer token is needed for the user cart and for submitting (see the absuite-login skill to authenticate).

definitions.name: absuite-catalog
definitions.description: Manage the product catalog in the Alliance Business Suite (ABS) via the REST API. Covers stock items (products), categories, types, families, brands, tags, images, attachments, attributes & options, bundles, reviews, questions, policy relationships (tax / shipping / return / refund / warranty), price-rule relationships, Google categories, and merchants, including atomic PATCH (JSON Patch) updates. Stock-item reads are anonymous (published items only) without a tenantId and a stock_items_read management read with one; writes require a tenantId, a stock_items_* permission and a bearer token (see the absuite-login skill to authenticate).

For routes the CLI does not cover, use the absuite-catalog REST skill.

All operations are tenant-scoped and require a bearer token (see the absuite-login skill to authenticate).

definitions.description: How the System area relates to the absuite CLI: the CLI has no system commands today, so this skill says what the CLI does cover and points to the absuite-system skill for the rest.

definitions.name: absuite-tenants
definitions.description: Manage tenant configuration in the Alliance Business Suite (ABS) via the REST API. The largest service, covers tenant CRUD, departments, enrollments (standard, extended, and employee), industries, invitations, options, positions, segments, sizes, teams, team records, team contact/project enrollments, territories, types, units, unit groups, licenses, notifications, web portals, avatars, carts, wallets, and social profiles, including atomic PATCH (JSON Patch) updates. Most operations are tenant-scoped and require a bearer token (see the absuite-login skill to authenticate).

definitions.name: absuite-tenants-cli
definitions.description: Drive the Alliance Business Suite (ABS) Tenants area with the absuite CLI: 54 commands (0 read, 54 write) under `absuite tenants`, each generated from the platform's ServiceClients and checked against `absuite commands -o json`. For routes the CLI does not cover, use the absuite-tenants REST skill.

definitions.name: absuite-users
definitions.description: Read and manage the current user's account in the Alliance Business Suite (ABS) via the REST API. Covers the `/api/v2/Me` surface, profile, extended profile, avatar, settings, addresses, cart, wallet, social profile, followers/follows, notifications, tenant memberships, enrollments, invitations, and user options (key-value metadata), including atomic PATCH (JSON Patch) updates. These endpoints are USER-scoped (resolved from the bearer token); they take NO tenantId. Requires a bearer token (see the absuite-login skill to authenticate).

definitions.name: absuite-users-cli
definitions.description: How the Users area relates to the absuite CLI: the CLI has no users commands today, so this skill says what the CLI does cover and points to the absuite-users skill for the rest.

definitions.name: absuite-wallets
definitions.description: Manage wallets and their sub-resources (bank accounts, payments, payment tokens, locations, withdraws/withdraw-requests) plus read access to orders, invoices, quotes, refunds and chargebacks, via the Alliance Business Suite (ABS) REST API. Covers create / read / update (PUT) / delete and PATCH (JSON Patch) where exposed. Wallets are addressed by walletId and gated on the caller owning the wallet; only bank accounts, tokens and locations take an optional tenantId. Agents cannot move money or add payment instruments. Every call requires a bearer token (see the absuite-login skill to authenticate).

definitions.name: absuite-wallets-cli
definitions.description: Drive the Alliance Business Suite (ABS) Wallets area with the absuite CLI: 6 commands (6 read, 0 write) under `absuite wallets`, each generated from the platform's ServiceClients and checked against `absuite commands -o json`. For routes the CLI does not cover, use the absuite-wallets REST skill.

definitions.name: Blog Authoring
definitions.description: Author and revise tenant blog posts through governed ABS Business Capabilities. Surveys existing posts to avoid duplication, drafts an article, and submits it for human approval: never bypassing the approval gate, never resubmitting a suspended write.

definitions.name: Deal Follow-up
definitions.description: Reads a tenant-owned deal and records one bounded governed follow-up note on it: a single idempotent, tenant-guarded write (RFC 6902 replace). Driven by a dealUnitId run input; the mutation happens ONCE (no ForEach), carries no external effect, and is replay-safe (re-running yields the same deal state).

definitions.name: Order Review
definitions.description: Reviews one sales order across bounded Commerce surfaces: reads the tenant-owned order, lists its order lines, and for each line looks up the referenced product through the published-only public catalog. Read-only (no mutation, no approval), driven by an orderId run input. Every product lookup is derived from an authorized order line's ItemId, not a caller-supplied id; the catalog read is Published-only. The per-line product lookup is demonstrative of Commerce composition across bounded surfaces, not mandatory business behavior (the line already carries item summary fields).

definitions.name: Project Task Review
definitions.description: Reviews one project and its tasks: reads the project, lists its tasks, then fetches each task's detail in a governed ForEach loop. A read-only first-party template driven by a projectId run input; no mutation, no approval, no financial consequence.

definitions.name: Wallet Invoice Review
definitions.description: Reads the tenant wallet and its invoices for review. A read-only first-party template: no mutation, no provider egress, no human approval, no financial consequence.
